notes: RULE 3 finding: alinea-stores.com is NOT the genuine Alinea catalogue and no rows were extracted. Evidence chain: (1) The real Alinea (French furniture/home-decor chain, Mulliez group) was placed in judicial liquidation by the Marseille commercial tribunal on 2026-03-31, closing ~36 stores and cutting ~1,200 jobs; the genuine site's online orders had already been suspended around 2026-02-26 (sources: lsa-conso.fr, cnews.fr, ecommercemag.fr, meuble-info.fr). The brand name/IP was later bought by MH France (French subsidiary of the Chinese group Aosom) on 2026-07-13, which stated it 'intends to relaunch' the Alinea website at some future point (lsa-conso.fr, boursorama.com) -- no evidence this relaunch is alinea-stores.com. (2) French consumer-fraud outlets (ici.fr, signal-arnaques.com, verifsites.com, fr.scamdoc.com, fr.trustpilot.com) report a wave of fraudulent copycat sites that sprang up exploiting the real Alinea's bankruptcy news, all using near-identical marketing: 'liquidation totale -80/-90%', 'destockage exceptionnel', missing legal notices, and in reported cases non-delivery / Hong-Kong payment processing. Named examples: alinea-official.com, alinea-officialstore.com, alineaofficialstore.com, alineaonline.shop, fralinaa.com, sale-alinea.top, alinea-france.com -- alinea-stores.com was not individually named in the sources found but is naming-pattern-identical to alinea-officialstore.com. (3) Direct evidence from the site itself: fetched https://www.alinea-stores.com/ (HTTP 200, direct fetch, no blocking) -- the <title> reads literally '🔴 FERMETURE DÉFINITIVE Alinea - LIQUIDATION TOTALE à -80% | Tout Part !' (word-for-word the scam template pattern described by the press). The nav uses Shopify-style /collections/<handle> URLs but the store is NOT genuine Shopify: /collections.json returns HTTP 404 to a soft-404 canonical (https://www.alinea-stores.com/404), assets are served from cdn.statics-cdn-im.com (not Shopify's CDN), and the page JS is a base64-obfuscated blob assigned to a generic template variable window._wwwalineastorescom_ alongside a generic /assets/system/order_runtime.js -- consistent with a white-label storefront template mill, not an established retailer's platform. A full-page scan of the homepage HTML found zero occurrences of SIRET, RCS, 'mentions legales', contact, or terms/CGV links -- absence of any legal notice is itself a documented red flag for this exact scam wave. Conclusion: this domain shows every hallmark of a fraudulent post-liquidation copycat site, not a real operating catalogue with genuine inventory/fulfillment. No categories were extracted because the listed 'products' cannot be treated as a real, verifiable catalogue -- extracting qty numbers from a suspected scam storefront would misrepresent fabricated/bait data as genuine retail coverage. Access route: direct fetch (no WAF encountered). No probe.py shopify/shopifycolls data available since collections.json 404s (consistent with the store not actually running Shopify despite URL cosmetics).
